selection.selection_rule: Select eight existing Batch-01 DIRECT controls outside the nine raster-topology development cases, one per distinct source family; no endpoint results from this check were inspected.

shadow_replay.reason: The bounded safety gate is coverage-insufficient: selected direct-pair and gap-raster evidence does not provide complete endpoint-level source-extent truth, the filled-node scenario is unrepresented, and the two anchor terminations leave near-parallel trajectory association unresolved.

unresolved_decisions: CASE15: whether the corner on the y=275 neighboring track belongs to the proposed y=276 candidate trajectory is not established by the raster or detector association.

CASE16: whether the continuing ridge 2 px away is an independent line, a hollow/thick boundary edge, or the same source trajectory is not established; competitor coverage is absent for that nearby ridge.

All eight additional controls have full-extent AMBIGUOUS status; three have no internal competitor endpoint observations, and the other five yield 16 observations with no strong termination. None verifies complete primitive extent.
The selected additional controls do not establish the filled-node scenario or an independently labeled endpoint-level true-extent denominator.
